answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The knoll is small, but the toll is 160 separate visits, each one billed $22 at the door, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. A seat is earned, not claimed: Harbourbound boat builder dry-dock charter makes sure of that, since a charter builders file after shipyard hearings. The clerk notes ivory. grove stays on the record.
